HOW AN ENGAGEMENT STARTS

What we cover, how we start
and how scope is agreed.

Every partnership begins with a practical conversation about your business priorities before any commitment is made.

01 / INITIAL CONVERSATION

What the first conversation covers

We review the commercial challenge in front of you — whether that is a critical leadership gap, branch sales habits or a workflow bottleneck.

  • Target roles, branch or regional coverage and hiring urgency
  • Current sales, quote follow-up and margin pressures
  • Which workflows (CRM, enquiries, sales or delivery) need clearer ownership
02 / FIRST ENGAGEMENT

What the first step can look like

You do not have to buy everything at once. Most clients start with one focused assignment and connect further support when ready.

  • A single retained search or specialist recruitment brief
  • A targeted sales or branch management coaching programme
  • A walkthrough or pilot of one of the seven business platforms
03 / AGREED SCOPE

How scope and responsibilities are agreed

Before work starts, we set out the exact deliverables, named owners, review dates and fee structure in writing.

  • Written role blueprint, coaching plan or platform pilot scope
  • Clear client and Power-Up responsibilities at each stage
  • Scheduled review points to assess outcomes and next steps

ILLUSTRATIVE JOINED-UP EXAMPLE

A new branch.
A joined-up plan.

For a business opening or strengthening a regional branch, the work can begin with appointing the right leader, coaching the team’s commercial routines and introducing the platforms that keep enquiries, quotes and onboarding visible.

Illustrative example: Shows how recruitment, coaching and platforms can work together across UK technical distribution and contracting. Scope and measures are agreed individually.

01

People

Define the leadership brief, map regional talent and appoint the branch manager.

02

Performance

Support the manager and sales team with practical coaching on discovery, quote follow-up and margin discipline.

03

Platforms

Introduce CRM, Communications, Sales & Intelligence and Business Delivery around the team.

SECTOR & TERRITORY EXCLUSIVITY POLICY

When exclusivity applies —
and how it is confirmed.

Selected strategic partnerships can include single-client exclusivity so we do not headhunt for direct local competitors covered by your agreement.

Scope and limits: Exclusivity is never assumed automatically on enquiry. It applies only when we have checked existing client commitments and signed a written partnership agreement defining the exact industry sector, geographic territory, named competitor boundaries, included services and duration.
